description: Scan source files for function/method declarations and identify those with no corresponding test file.

extensions.description: File extensions to include, e.g. [".ts", ".js"]. Defaults to [".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx"].

source_dir.description: Directory containing source files to scan.

test_dir.description: Directory containing test files. Defaults to same directory as source.

name: find_untested_functions
title: Find Untested Functions
